title: Crüger to Müller, August 1623
author: Peter Crüger
summary: Crüger thanks Müller for Kepler's latest writings, which, as an Italian said, are as marvellous as the man, and which carry him out of himself whenever he reads them.

notes.note: The 1927 editors' guess. Giovanni Antonio Magini of Bologna died in 1617.
